# AQadeer GEO.Com (AQadeergeo.com)
> AQadeer GEO.Com is the SEO, GEO (generative engine optimization) and digital marketing services website of Abdul Qadeer, based in Lahore, Pakistan and working online worldwide.

## Who
- Founder: Abdul Qadeer (also known as Abdul Qadeer GEO, Abdul Qadeer Digital, AQadeergeo)
- Brand names: AQadeer GEO.Com, AQadeergeo.com, AQadeer.com, AQadeerseo, AQadeergeo
- Abdul Qadeer is the Founder of Al Qadeer Digital Agency (Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/alqadeerdigitalagency)
- Certified in SEO by the DigiSkills Training Program (DSTP 3.0, 2026, Certificate ID ZKUY2X3MK, verify at https://digiskills.pk/verify) and in Graphic Design (DigiSkills, 2024)
- Around 5 years of restaurant menu creation and food photo listing experience (Foodora/foodpanda)
